biggest_catch: There is no official published pay figure — each project invitation carries its own compensation offer, so you only learn the rate after being invited to a specific project; the $25 catalog claim could not be matched to any official figure, and task availability (and therefore income) is never guaranteed.
catches: No official fixed pay figure for translation/AI-community work — rates are set per project invitation and vary by project, locale, and task type.
Zero guaranteed tasks: this is AI-data gig work (rating, annotation, evaluation, translation, localization) offered per project; availability fluctuates.
Project-specific qualification exams and ID verification are required; some projects require exams you must pass before any paid work.
Effective hourly pay can be low: independent-contractor rater work is widely reported in the ~$10-15/hr band and task-based work can pay pennies per task (third-party figures, NOT official).

Payment is monthly with a lag (earnings processed after month-end, typically within ~30 days per community docs), and minimums apply: $10 for PayPal, $100 for bank transfers — small balances roll over.
You work as an independent contractor, not an employee — no benefits, and the 'TELUS International AI Community' framing means you are crowdsourced labor, not staff.

c1.evidence: Lionbridge is a real, long-operating language/AI-data company; its crowdsourcing program (formerly The Smart Crowd, then Lionbridge AI) now operates as the TELUS Digital AI Community / AI Community by TELUS International.

c2.evidence: Official AI Community contributor documentation publishes the pay mechanism: 'Each project invitation will include a specific compensation offer. Since rates may vary by project, you can decide whether to participate on a case-by-case basis.' Payment methods and minimums are officially documented: PayPal, wire transfer, ACH, eCheck, SEPA; minimum payout $10 USD (PayPal) / $100 USD (bank transfers).

c3.evidence: No upfront fee — official postings note 'TELUS International will never request a monetary deposit for any role or project with the company.'

c4.evidence: Community documentation describes a monthly payment cycle: earnings for a month are processed and released within ~30 days after month-end (minimum balance + e-invoice submission required).

eligibility: 18+; pass project-specific qualification exams and ID verification; meet per-project requirements (language proficiency, residency, device/internet). Independent-contractor relationship. AI-data-work nature: evaluating AI responses, labeling/annotating data, rating search results and content, voice recording/transcription, translation and localization tasks — you train/improve AI models, not salaried employment.

steps: Create your AI Community account on the official TELUS Digital AI / AI Community portal.
Complete your contributor profile (languages, services, experience, address).
Pass the qualification exam(s) for the project(s) you want, and complete ID verification.
Accept a project invitation — each invitation states its specific compensation offer; decline if the rate is too low.
Complete tasks to the project's quality standards.
Submit any required e-invoice through the AI Community Portal at month-end.
Get paid on the monthly cycle once you clear the minimum ($10 PayPal / $100 bank transfer); payment via PayPal, wire, ACH, eCheck, or SEPA depending on country.
timing: Monthly payment cycle — earnings for a given month are processed and released within ~30 days after month-end, once the minimum balance is reached and required e-invoices are submitted.
